title: Chili Nutella Tapenade Spring Rolls
description: A unique fusion of Chinese spring rolls with the flavors of Nutella and tapenade.

ingredients.name: Wonton wrappers
ingredients.notes: usually found in the refrigerated section

instructions: 1. Lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface.
2. Place a small amount of Nutella, tapenade, marinated tofu, cucumber, and carrots in the center of the wrapper.
3. Brush the edges of the wrapper with a small amount of water.
4. Fold the bottom half of the wrapper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
5. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
6. Heat 1-2 inches of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
7. When the oil is hot, add a few of the spring rolls to the skillet and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
8. Remove the spring rolls from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
9. Serve the spring rolls hot with a drizzle of olive oil and a sprinkle of green onions.
10. Garnish with additional tapenade if desired.
